metadataReview.note: The Icelandic Wikipedia, drawing on Sturlunga saga, places the 1208 battle between Kolbeinn Tumason's following and Bishop Guðmundur Arason's men on the lands of the farm Víðines in Hjaltadalur, close to the episcopal seat at Hólar; the Skagafjörður archives catalogue a work titled Víðinesbardagi í Hjaltadal 1208. The atlas point is the gazetteer feature for the Víðines farmyard in Skagafjörður. It is a farm-sector reference, not a surveyed field position, and the existing year-precision date is retained. Strengths, losses and equipment are not inferred.
